statement: The browser verifier MUST run the vendored `@s0fractal/warrant` 0.11.0 only if every vendored file matches the pinned manifest and the embedded WASM matches the package's `build.json`.

decisions.because: The browser verifier runs a vendored copy of @s0fractal/warrant 0.10.0; pinning it is what makes it the reader's verifier rather than whatever a CDN serves.
The vendored verifier moves to @s0fractal/warrant 0.11.0, the first release with requireBound; pinned by npm integrity sha512-NWu9…AwA== and per-file SHA-256, checked against the registry tarball.
